title: The saw filer
logline: The filing room: a man at a bench with a bandsaw blade looped around the room, filing one tooth, from behind, a lamp over him. The mill's most careful job, drawn with the most careful line in the sequence.

panels.composition: A small filing room with a long bandsaw blade looped around the walls, a man from behind at a bench under a lamp filing a single tooth, files in a rack, Era I spotting in the shadows.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a small mill filing room with a long bandsaw blade looped around the walls and a man seen from behind at a bench under a lamp filing a single tooth, files in a rack, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: One tooth. The most careful line.
